board: CJMCU-1080 HDC1080 temperature & humidity module (4-pin: GND, SCL, SDA, VCC)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. The model uses 16-bit registers with 14-bit T/RH words (low 2 bits zero) per TI's formulas, plus the ID and config registers; the driver checks the IDs, sets config 0x1000 and does a triggered sequential 4-byte read.
